name: json-model
title: Robust JSON model (Dart)
prompt:
Fix `Student.fromJson` / `toJson` in `student.dart` (keep the class fields and constructor):
- `id` may arrive as an int or a numeric string (`"42"`)
- `birth` may be missing or null (-> null) or an ISO date/date-time string
- `grades` may be missing or null (-> empty list) and may mix ints and doubles (-> doubles)
- `toJson` writes `birth` as `YYYY-MM-DD` (zero-padded) or null, `grades` as doubles, `id` as int,
  so that `Student.fromJson(s.toJson())` round-trips
